high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a webpage from the Fondazione Bruno Kessler (FBK) magazine, viewed on a mobile device. The webpage features an article discussing the importance of measurement and quantification in science, particularly in the context of modern scientific research. The text references Galileo Galilei, highlighting his understanding of the value of measurement to know and manipulate the world.
